scenarios.request: Explain the difference between a retry and an idempotency guarantee without changing any project files.
Review the current release evidence and report whether the service is production ready; do not change files or deploy.
Review a lockfile-only dependency update and its provenance without installing packages or modifying the repository.
Diagnose a recurring worker latency regression from existing telemetry and code, but do not implement or release a fix.
Design a scalable subsystem even though the acceptance criteria and ownership boundary are not yet measurable.
Correct one punctuation mark in a static README sentence and verify the rendered text.
Add one focused unit test for existing local behavior and run only the relevant trusted test entrypoint.
Add a normal feature inside one unfamiliar existing module and verify its caller-visible behavior.
Refactor a small parser for readability while preserving every observable input, output, and error contract.
Fix a reproducible authentication bypass in unfamiliar code and verify unauthorized access remains denied.
Add a validated create operation for ordinary non-sensitive persisted data with focused persistence tests.
Add a backward-compatible database column and a bounded resumable backfill without executing it in a shared environment.
Execute the already reviewed production repair backfill that overwrites customer records, using its verified recovery plan.
Add a third-party runtime parser package, update its lockfile, inspect install hooks, and verify the local build.
Replace a quadratic matching loop over user-sized data with a bounded implementation and a representative benchmark.
Add bounded payload validation and contextual error reporting to an existing queue worker while explicitly preserving its current delivery, ordering, retry, and idempotency semantics.
Change a local accessible interaction that has no form, sensitive data, or external side effect.
Add a customer-facing form that submits established personal-data fields within the approved trust boundary.
Design consent, retention, deletion, export, and residency behavior for a new customer profile data lifecycle.
Build an AI assistant that retrieves untrusted documents and proposes bounded tool calls with abstention and evaluations.
Implement model-assisted account updates involving regulated records with human approval and fail-closed authorization.
Implement a compatible public API replacement and deprecation path for consumers deployed on independent schedules.
Design a canary rollout, rollback decision, and feature-flag lifecycle without changing deployment configuration or releasing.
Deploy the already verified version to the shared production environment now, without editing repository files.
Publish the already built and verified public package version to its remote registry.
Rotate the production database credential using the reviewed dual-secret procedure and verified rollback path.
Apply the already verified authentication hotfix during the active production incident without making new repository edits.
Define the smallest valuable scope and falsifiable success evidence for a new internal approval workflow.
Plan a multi-tenant product while demand, workflow, feasibility, cost, safety, and ownership remain materially uncertain.
Add a cursor-paginated external endpoint without breaking existing SDK consumers or changing established errors.
Design the model, transactions, indexes, and query plan for a growing tenant-scoped order ledger.
Design an at-least-once event workflow with duplicates, reordering, retries, partitions, and partial outages.
Design an infrastructure-as-code runtime platform with explicit identity, network, secret, capacity, and recovery boundaries.
Redesign a slow flaky cross-service test suite and define trustworthy, risk-linked release evidence.
Coordinate a high-impact outage plan, assign workstreams, contain impact, and define recovery evidence without live mutation.
Sequence a cross-team migration, delegate outcomes, resolve ownership, and define review and escalation boundaries.
Correct and verify a queue-saturation runbook while preserving guarded production actions and recovery prerequisites.
Specify and model-check an authorization state machine for irreversible financial transfers without executing any transfer.
Add a typed runtime feature flag with safe defaults, owner, expiry, kill switch, and focused configuration tests.
Design a new shared service boundary and ownership contract only after showing why a local module is insufficient.
Create the specifically authorized reversible issue-tracker record in the external project without changing repository files.
Send the final security-incident disclosure to all affected customers now as the official public communication.
Review a provided one-line engineering explanation for factual clarity without changing repository files or external state.
Assess a low-impact dependency advisory against the current lockfile and build path; there is no credible active compromise or material exposure, and no packages may be changed or installed.
Assess evidence that a dependency source may be malicious and the release build path may be compromised, without changing packages, credentials, artifacts, or external systems.
Change the server CORS allowlist and security headers for a new trusted application origin, preserving existing origins and adding focused policy tests.
Restart the explicitly authorized disposable staging worker once through its existing control; it serves no production users or data and has verified automatic recovery.

Review a bounded validation change inside an established authentication boundary; it does not change authentication logic, authorization, privileges, tenant scope, secrets, or data exposure, and no files may be edited.

Review the resilience design for the sole customer transaction control plane; a prolonged failure could halt every customer operation and cause material organizational loss, but there is no active incident, no repository change, and no external action.
Design the safeguards and evaluation plan for an AI system whose recommendations could materially influence employment termination decisions; do not change files or operate any system.
Apply the explicitly authorized reversible role change to one isolated non-production sandbox account; it cannot access production data, expand privilege, transfer ownership, or affect other users.
